title: Let's Do 'til Midnight
description: Added what I believe are appropriate comfort tags to a majority of the "Let's Do!" mod catalogue.
body:
Added what I believe are appropriate comfort tags to a majority of the "Let's Do!" mod catalogue. I only did the mods I use, so there are a handful that I haven't covered, and I will not cover, unless I decide to start using those mods.

### _Please Note_
I'm specifically using the Farm & Charm version of many of the "Let's Do" mod, but I don't think that changes the block ids, so these should still work for the original versions. However, I haven't tested this with the non-"Farm & Charm" versions.

## Mods covered
- [Let's Do] Alpine Whispers
- [Let's Do] Bakery (- Farm&Charm Compat)
- [Let's Do] Beachparty
- [Let's Do] Brewery (- Farm&Charm Compat)
- [Let's Do] Camping
- [Let's Do] Candlelight (-Farm&Charm Compat)
- [Let's Do] Farm & Charm
- [Let's Do] Furniture
- [Let's Do] Hearth & Timber
- [Let's Do] HerbalBrews
- [Let's Do] Lili's Lucky Lures
- [Let's Do] Lili's Pottery
- [Let's Do] Meadow
- [Let's Do] Vinery

You can crack open the zip to see where I allocated various blocks and adjust as you see fit. It's best to use these as a default.
